Hi Evan — appreciate the clarity. I drafted a short MAP and a kickoff sequence; attaching a draft for your review. Below is the proposed cadence and ownership to meet the end-of-May target:

1) Week 1 (Apr 22–26): Kickoff + org creation
   - Owner: CardioPulse (Evan, Ben) — provide CIDR blocks, service account email for peering
   - Owner: Redwood (Jonas) — create staging org, pre-configure SSO placeholder, generate initial ephemeral API key flow

2) Week 2 (Apr 29–May 3): Network allowlist & peering
   - Owner: CardioPulse (network eng) — add Redwood IPs to allowlist; share test endpoints
   - Owner: Redwood (Marissa) — validate peering path and routing, provide fallback VPN instructions

3) Week 3 (May 6–10): Ingest smoke tests + perf baseline
   - Owners: Joint — run scripted ingest, capture latency and token-cost profile

4) Week 4 (May 13–24): Iteration and acceptance
   - Owners: Joint — implement quick optimizations (batching/kv cache) and confirm acceptance criteria

Action items for today: please confirm target environment (staging vs prod-like), which team will initiate the VPC peering request, and whether you want us to generate the initial API key or if you will use your own service account. I’ve cc’ed Marissa and Neha for the engineering handoff.

Kickoff slot: I’m available Thu 4/20 10:00–11:00 PT and Fri 4/21 08:00–10:00 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0121

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@cardiopulse.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-04-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC & MAP — technical checklist

Hi team — quick tech note + minimal checklist to make the handoff actionable. Copying the relevant bits into this thread so it’s easy to paste into your runbook.

Minimal environment steps (Redwood staging tenant):
- Org & tenancy: Redwood creates an org namespace for CardioPulse staging. We need a service-account email (IAM principal) to grant peering and secrets access. Please provide the principal in the format: svc-cardiope@cardiopulse.com
- API keys: We provide a short-lived bootstrap key for smoke tests; recommend using our ephemeral key + your service account for production testing.
- IP allowlist: Start with the specific /32 addresses in your CSV for immediate access. We will provide a list of egress IPs (4 addresses) to add to your firewall. If you prefer CIDR ranges, we can provide /28 aggregates.
- VPC peering options:
  * Preferred: cloud-provider VPC peering (route-based) — requires your VPC CIDR and us to accept peering request.
  * Fallback: IPsec VPN tunnel — used when peering constraints exist.
- Ports and endpoints: HTTPS to api.redwood.ai:443; outbound to our egress IPs for all control-plane calls. No other ports required.

Estimated lead times once we have the service account and confirmed CIDRs: 24–48 hours to provision staging org and seed keys; peering may take 24–72 hours depending on your cloud ops window.

Small ask: please share the person who will raise the peering request and their preferred contact. I attached a short snippet that lists the concrete API endpoints and sample curl commands for seeding the key.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

[Attachment: network_instructions_snippet.txt (text/plain)]
